name: Daphira
summary: Daphira features a choice of supple imitation leather or finely woven fabric, each bringing its own character to the design. The seat rests on a base of brushed bronze steel, its warm metallic finish adding depth and quiet radiance. With fluid lines and a poised silhouette, it carries an air of refinement and distinction, a piece that lends interiors both comfort and enduring elegance. 63x59x85
